unavailable_years.2018: ETHUSD is missing 2018-01-12. Both assets use the common complete window. Timestamp-only precheck and rejected draft retained before any new performance evaluation; no gap filling.

windows: Separate flat-start annual windows from January 1 opening through December 31 opening. Preserve prior warm-up; omit the last daily interval of each year consistently. No annual cash reset is represented as an executable portfolio.
matched_control_requirement: 2025 gross and fee-40 full index artifacts must equal the previous Kraken pilot artifacts; 25-versus-40 decisions must be identical. Only fee changes in that comparison.
fees_are: 25 bps per side is Kairos's Alpaca planning reserve, not a verified historical/account fee. Stress changes spread/slippage without changing that reserve.

inference.family: 2 assets x 2 references x (7 available annual windows + 1 unavailable 2018 window + 1 pooled series); retain the original conservative 36-comparison correction; Alpaca-25 base case only

advance_gate: For BOTH assets: adequate pooled sample; at least five positive years and positive median annual change under both Alpaca-25 base and friction stress; positive multiplicity-adjusted pooled lower bounds against cash and passive. Passing authorizes only an offline risk-constrained follow-up, never paper activation.
pooling: Concatenate dated annual daily return observations without filling omitted boundaries. Moving blocks cannot cross missing year-boundary intervals. No joined lifetime portfolio return is reported. Historical regime weighting is not a forecast of future regime frequencies.
adaptation: Reuse the frozen daily price-index implementation. No fitting, parameter search, optimizer, volatility overlay, calibration, or selection of a favorable year/scenario.
risk_boundary: Unfunded, unconstrained price indices omit execution minima, liquidity and Kairos risk controls. They neither fix nor pass the prior execution-validity gate. Risk-constrained simulation remains a separate prerequisite to any forward paper consideration.
status: Retrospective exploratory chronological evaluation, not a blind test or fitted walk-forward model. 2025 was already examined; all 2026 data and the consumed final window remain excluded.
